SELECT A.APPOINTMENT_NUMBER AS appointmentNumber,
A.APPOINTMENT_NUMBER AS reservationsNumber,
A.MEMBER_NUMBER AS memberNumber,
A.MEMBER_NUMBER AS patientNumber,
M.MEMBER_NAME AS patientName,
M.MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER AS phone,
A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN AS attendingPhysician,
A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN AS employeeCode,
NVL( DM.MEMBER_NAME, A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN ) AS employeeName,
E.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS deptCode,
NVL( DP.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '진료과 미지정' ) AS deptName,
A.RESERVATION_START_DATE AS reservationStartDate,
A.RESERVATION_START_DATE AS reservedAt,
A.RESERVATION_END_DATE AS reservationEndDate,
TO_CHAR( A.RESERVATION_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) AS reservationStartDateText,
TO_CHAR( A.RESERVATION_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) AS reservedAtText,
TO_CHAR( A.RESERVATION_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) AS reservationEndDateText,
A.RESERVATION_STATUS AS reservationStatus,
A.RESERVATION_STATUS AS reservationsStatus,
CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS reservationsCreatedAt,
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(16)) AS reservationsCreatedAtText,
'PATIENT' AS reservationSource,
A.SYMPTOMS AS symptoms,
A.COLOR AS color
FROM APPOINTMENT A
LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON A.MEMBER_NUMBER = M.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN MEMBER DM ON A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN = DM.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN = E.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT DP ON E.DEPARTMENT_CODE = DP.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE A.MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}
ORDER BY A.RESERVATION_START_DATE DESC NULLS LAST,
A.APPOINTMENT_NUMBER DESC

SELECT A.APPOINTMENT_NUMBER AS appointmentNumber,
A.APPOINTMENT_NUMBER AS reservationsNumber,
A.MEMBER_NUMBER AS memberNumber,
A.MEMBER_NUMBER AS patientNumber,
M.MEMBER_NAME AS patientName,
M.MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER AS phone,
A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN AS attendingPhysician,
A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN AS employeeCode,
NVL( DM.MEMBER_NAME, A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN ) AS employeeName,
E.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS deptCode,
NVL( DP.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '진료과 미지정' ) AS deptName,
A.RESERVATION_START_DATE AS reservationStartDate,
A.RESERVATION_START_DATE AS reservedAt,
A.RESERVATION_END_DATE AS reservationEndDate,
TO_CHAR( A.RESERVATION_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) AS reservationStartDateText,
TO_CHAR( A.RESERVATION_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) AS reservedAtText,
TO_CHAR( A.RESERVATION_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) AS reservationEndDateText,
A.RESERVATION_STATUS AS reservationStatus,
A.RESERVATION_STATUS AS reservationsStatus,
CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS reservationsCreatedAt,
CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(16)) AS reservationsCreatedAtText,
'PATIENT' AS reservationSource,
A.SYMPTOMS AS symptoms,
A.COLOR AS color
FROM APPOINTMENT A
LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON A.MEMBER_NUMBER = M.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN MEMBER DM ON A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN = DM.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN = E.MEMBER_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT DP ON E.DEPARTMENT_CODE = DP.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE A.APPOINTMENT_NUMBER = #{appointmentNumber}
AND A.MEMBER_NUMBER = #{memberNumber}

SELECT DISTINCT D.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS deptCode,
D.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS deptName
FROM DEPARTMENT D
INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON D.DEPARTMENT_CODE = E.DEPARTMENT_CODE
INNER JOIN AUTHORITY A ON E.MEMBER_NUMBER = A.MEMBER_NUMBER
WHERE E.POSITION_CODE = 'N01'
AND A.PERMISSION_NAME = 'ROLE_DOCTOR'
ORDER BY D.DEPARTMENT_CODE

SELECT DISTINCT E.MEMBER_NUMBER AS employeeCode,
M.MEMBER_NAME AS employeeName,
E.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS deptCode,
D.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS deptName
FROM EMPLOYEE E
INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON E.MEMBER_NUMBER = M.MEMBER_NUMBER
INNER JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON E.DEPARTMENT_CODE = D.DEPARTMENT_CODE
INNER JOIN AUTHORITY A ON E.MEMBER_NUMBER = A.MEMBER_NUMBER
WHERE E.POSITION_CODE = 'N01'
AND A.PERMISSION_NAME = 'ROLE_DOCTOR'
ORDER BY E.DEPARTMENT_CODE, M.MEMBER_NAME

SELECT DISTINCT E.MEMBER_NUMBER AS employeeCode,
M.MEMBER_NAME AS employeeName,
E.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS deptCode,
D.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS deptName
FROM EMPLOYEE E
INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON E.MEMBER_NUMBER = M.MEMBER_NUMBER
INNER JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON E.DEPARTMENT_CODE = D.DEPARTMENT_CODE
INNER JOIN AUTHORITY A ON E.MEMBER_NUMBER = A.MEMBER_NUMBER
WHERE E.DEPARTMENT_CODE = #{deptCode}
AND E.POSITION_CODE = 'N01'
AND A.PERMISSION_NAME = 'ROLE_DOCTOR'
ORDER BY M.MEMBER_NAME

SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT E.MEMBER_NUMBER )
FROM EMPLOYEE E
INNER JOIN AUTHORITY A ON E.MEMBER_NUMBER = A.MEMBER_NUMBER
WHERE E.MEMBER_NUMBER = #{employeeCode}
AND E.DEPARTMENT_CODE = #{deptCode}
AND E.POSITION_CODE = 'N01'
AND A.PERMISSION_NAME = 'ROLE_DOCTOR'

FROM APPOINTMENT A
WHERE A.ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN = #{employeeCode}
